question: What is the meaning of compositional elements in relation to product information?
description: The compositional elements refer to the materials and itemized substances that make up a product, including their mass fractions and any critical or secondary materials. This information is typically provided in a Product Content Declaration (PCDS) and is used to assess the environmental impact and sustainability of a product.
